senses.gloss: m. pl., constr. דְּמֵי (דמה) equivalent, compensation; (cmp. שָׁוָה) price, value; payment.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 112b:11">Pes. 112ᵇ</cite> do not bargain <he>בשעה שאין לך ד׳</he> when thou hast no money to pay with.

<cite ref="Keritot 13b:47">Kerith. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ וערכין</he> the assessment of an object to be redeemed or of an object the value of which was dedicated, v. <cite ref="P01377"><he>עֶרֶךְ</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 32a:2">Pes. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>לפי מידה … או לפי ד׳ וכ׳</he> must he pay the fine according to quantity or according to value?—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:6">Kidd. I, 6</cite> <he>כל הנעשה ד׳ באחר</he> whatever is used as payment for another object; expl.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 28a:10">ib. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הנישום ד׳ וכ׳</he> whatever is assessed as an equivalent, i.e. an exchange is meant and not a sale for cash.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 28b:4">Ib. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>החליף דמי שור בפרה</he> if he gives a cow in payment of money which he owes for an ox; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:22">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>נהוג נשיאותך בד׳</he> Ar. conduct thy office of Nasi as something valuable (Var. in Ar., a. ed. <he>ברָמִים</he>).
